status: ANALYSIS_ONLY; v1 and v2 NOT_ACCEPTED; no animation/art acceptance

registration.method: ONE isotropic whole-figure scale, crown/top boundary to y0 and lowest shoe/body bottom boundary to y67; horizontal translation aligns the midpoint of both lowest shoe-material row centers to source125 x24.5. No rotation, shear, per-part transform, image resampling, or image output.
registration.normalization: Source body-palette proxy H=67, excluding contract shadow RGB(16,8,8). V2 alpha>128 H=1147; alpha0 haze is not a body extent.
registration.coordinate_caution: Lowest occupied pixel row and its lower boundary differ by one pixel. Contract row-index convention gives source hand36/67=53.73%; continuous lower-edge convention gives37/67=55.22%. Never subtract quantities with mixed conventions.

interpretation.robust_failure: Hands are much too low and too close to the center. Lowest-row vertical residuals are approximately+10.8 logical pixels; true bottom-edge residuals approximately+9.8. Registered hand span is~19.5% narrower than source125.
interpretation.lower_confidence_findings: Elbow-region sleeve folds tend lower; shoulder-top ridge tends wider. Neither is a recovered skeleton joint. Crown/hair envelope is nominally~9% wider and~29% taller; interval uncertainty means this is not a precise whole-head resize instruction.
interpretation.relative_strengths_to_preserve: Matte woven brown-gray long work coat, closed stand collar and central zipper, restrained light work panels, near-shoe hem, small shoe tips and nearly level shoe-bottom material.
interpretation.projection: Redraw high-angle compact projection and relaxed arms using source125 as geometry reference; do not infer a numerical 3D camera angle, pose joints, toe anatomy or support-foot identity from these pixels.

next_step: A new single base may be generated only by the separately authorized owner. Reassess the new raw under the same whole-figure registration; no animation/art acceptance follows from these measurements.
